entities.summary: Titi Robin (b. 1957-08-26, Rochefort-sur-Loire) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Rochefort-sur-Loire and France. Known in the fields of france, composers & musicians, europe.
